video_caption: The video features two men conversing in what appears to be a podcast setting, with the camera alternating between them. The first man, seen from the waist up, wears a black t-shirt, a red baseball cap with a white "K" on it, and multiple gold chains, along with visible tattoos on his arms. He sits in front of a blue microphone on a stand, and at one point, holds up a green paper while speaking. Behind him, there's a cluttered background with shelves, boxes, and a sign that reads "WORD TO WHO." The second man, also seen from the waist up, wears a grey zip-up hoodie and a gold chain, with his black, curly hair styled in an afro. He sits in a black leather armchair against a plain yellow wall, speaking into a black microphone on a stand. Both men are actively engaged in conversation, with their expressions changing as they speak and listen.

He speaks into a microphone with a blue foam cover, often smiling or looking engaged, and at one point holds a small green object in his hands. On a white box in his immediate foreground, the text "WORD TO WHO V WORD" is visible. Both men appear to be engaged in an active discussion.

The man on the right, wearing a black t-shirt, several gold necklaces, and a red baseball cap with a prominent white "K" (likely representing "K" as a logo or initial), is seated on the floor. His background is a more cluttered room with shelves holding various items, including more hats with the letter "K", boxes, and what appears to be audio equipment, including a box with the text "WORD TO WHO". Both men have microphones in front of them, indicating they are recording audio. They exchange dialogue, with the man on the right also using hand gestures and smiling, suggesting a lighthearted or engaging conversation.
